about.heading: Commercial lead with an engineer's eye.
paragraphs: I'm a D2C and eCommerce lead with a technical background. I started in Nestle IT - web security, hosting and CI for 30+ brand websites - moved into SEO and paid search for Purina, ran the Nestle Infant Nutrition eShop end to end, and since 2024 have owned the D2C channel for Ploom at JTI in Dubai.
That mix lets me speak the language of both brand teams and engineers: I set the commercial direction, write requirements developers can build from, and keep agencies and partners delivering on time.
about.photoAlt: Mikhail Buzumurga speaking at an internal event

jobs.title: D2C eShop Manager
bullets: Business owner of the ploom.ae D2C store launch (project May 2024 - Oct 2025): requirements, Adobe Commerce (Magento) platform, OMS and delivery integrations, configuration and content. Delivered on time together with global agency and engineering partners.
Run the store end to end with a lean two-person team: trading, CRM, UX and operations.
Built retention mechanics: Ploom Club loyalty, Refer a Friend, post-purchase survey, abandoned-cart recovery via email, SMS and WhatsApp.
Since Feb 2026 also own paid media for the brand (programmatic and Meta).
Lead AI-visibility (GEO) work: monitoring how the brand appears in ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI assistants.

jobs.title: DTC eShop Manager
bullets: Fully responsible for the [nestlebaby.ru](https://www.nestlebaby.ru/brands) online store, working completely on the DTC model, together with agencies and business partners.
Drove expansion into 21+ cities within 6 months, delivered 10+ UX improvements and launched targeted promo campaigns using RFM CRM segmentation.
Integrated additional products with the Nestle Health Science unit, boosting traffic and sales; migrated the eShop to a new warehouse to improve profitability and operations.

jobs.title: Senior Search and WebDev Specialist
bullets: Managed the paid search and WebDev budget within a long-term SEO and paid search strategy for all Purina brands.
Orchestrated end-to-end development of 30+ promo and landing page projects with digital agencies, media planners and brand managers.
Built a joint search placement approach with key eCommerce clients together with the eCom team.
Coordinated content development and placement across websites - 200+ articles created.

jobs.title: SEO and Paid Search Specialist
bullets: Managed agencies and partners to develop and run a long-term SEO and paid search strategy for 9+ Purina brands.
Delivered a 728% increase in overall site traffic and significantly improved positions in Yandex and Google.
Defined KPIs, managed campaign planning and budgets, technical SEO and content placement with brand teams.
more: Coordinated agencies and technical teams on the implementation of technical recommendations.
Managed the project plan for content implementation by brands and channels.
Continuously optimized paid placement and SEO, testing keywords, ads and landing pages with agencies to increase ROI.
Set up reporting on key indicators with agencies, partners and analysts across digital channels.

jobs.title: Junior Business Analyst
bullets: Passed the KPMG ISMS audit (ISO 27001 confirmed) and the Roskomnadzor personal data audit as owner of digital security control.
Managed implementation of a PIM system, a CRM system, hosting infrastructure for websites in Kazakhstan and the Nespresso RU mobile app - from business requirements to go-live.
Certified 4 private cloud solutions together with providers and business owners.
more: Managed deployment, publishing, security verification, QA, code review and decommissioning of 13 sites: purina-dentalife.ru, esldostlar.az, promobreak.kz and others.
Responsible for security and compliance of 36 digital assets (websites, mobile apps, social applications) in Russia and the CIS.
Built reports in Power BI; owned relationships with hosting partners.

jobs.title: Junior System Analyst
bullets: Oversaw security and compliance for 31 digital assets across Russia and the CIS.
Led the migration of 21 sites to a continuous integration setup (Jenkins, GitLab, Capistrano).
Built an information portal with a ticketing system in SharePoint - request processing time went down from 1 hour to 10 minutes, 783 tickets created.
more: Managed deployment, publishing, security verification, QA and code review of 11 sites: proplan.ru, nestlebaby.ru, nestlehealthscience.ru and others.
Launched the Purina Partners Conference mobile app.
Coached Russian web agencies on secure and compliant corporate web development.

jobs.title: Digital Trainee
bullets: Ensured security and compliance of about 28 websites, including maggi.ru, kitkat.ru and nespresso.ru.
Took part in deployment, QA and decommissioning of 8 sites and in communication between business, agencies and hosting providers.

items.quote: I had the pleasure of working with Mikhail on the launch of the Ploom.ae website in the UAE, where he served as the business owner for both the website and e-commerce scope. [...] He consistently provided clear business direction, made well-informed decisions, and paid close attention to detail across configuration, features, and content.

items.name: Caterina Antonelli
items.quote: During our collaboration, he has always demonstrated a strong sense of ownership, ensuring that deliverables were completed on time and with high quality, even under demanding deadlines. [...] He brings a solid understanding of digital best practices and is able to balance business needs with practical, user-focused solutions.

items.name: Fahath Mohamed
items.quote: As an engineer, I really valued how clearly he framed requirements and how well he understood the technical side, including the OMS and integrations. [...] The site was fully ready and launched on time. A strong, technically literate business lead I would gladly work with again.

items.name: Elizaveta Lavrinenko
items.quote: Leading the Search, SEO, and Web Development efforts, Mikhail brought a level of professionalism and strategic insight that truly stood out. His knack for organizing complex projects and keeping everyone - brand teams, developers, and agencies - on the same page was impressive and ensured we met our goals consistently.

items.name: Yury Scherbakov
items.quote: He is the one who literally built Nestle Purina Search strategy, optimizing the budgets and delivering positive ROI.

items.name: Anton Shostak
items.quote: Mikhail is a talented and advanced project manager, who is continuously searching ways to implement innovations in ways of working. [...] Numerous times he was helping web-agencies, directing them and advising on best possible approaches. It was a great pleasure for me to work with Mikhail on a large datacenter setup project, where he proved to be well organised, result-focused and client-oriented.
